::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru AI company founded 2018 (about 80 staff, mostly software). Its ExSLerate NPU IP is FPGA-validated; the Krsna AI SoC is in design with first silicon expected in 2026. No tape-out yet.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Edge-AI NPU IP (ExSLerate), the Krsna AI SoC in development, and AI models and software tools.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Edge-AI NPU and inference SoC design.
- **IP ownership 4/5:** Own ExSLerate NPU IP and the Krsna SoC design.
- **Design completeness 1/5:** NPU IP only FPGA-validated; Krsna SoC still in design, no tape-out.
- **Market readiness 1/5:** Pre-silicon; first silicon expected in 2026.
